verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an API endpoint for bulk-deleting accounts and visitors without contacting support. That is a genuine first-party bulk operation, but it covers only one narrow operation type (deletion). Data-sync exports are bulk data movement rather than bulk operations on items, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: bulk update/edit operations across guides, segments, or other items, AI/agent-driven bulk actions (e.g. via Leo or MCP), depth on batch limits and behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
